recipes.title: Veggie omelette
recipes.description: Fluffy eggs folded around whatever veg you have.
steps: Whisk 2–3 eggs with a pinch of salt.
Soften chopped veg in a hot oiled pan.
Pour in the eggs, cook gently and fold when just set.

recipes.title: Shakshuka
recipes.description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.
steps: Fry onion, garlic and pepper until soft.
Add tomatoes, cumin and paprika; simmer 10 minutes.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook until the whites set.

recipes.title: Potato frittata
recipes.description: A thick oven omelette that tidies up the fridge.
steps: Fry sliced potato and onion until golden.
Add other veg, pour over beaten eggs.
Finish under the grill until puffed and set.

recipes.title: Scrambled eggs on toast
recipes.description: The five-minute classic.
steps: Toast the bread.
Stir eggs slowly in a buttered pan over low heat.
Season and pile onto the toast.

recipes.title: Guacamole
recipes.description: Ripe avocado, lime and a little crunch.
steps: Mash the avocado with lemon or lime juice and salt.
Fold in finely chopped tomato and onion.
Serve straight away with chips or veg.

recipes.title: Avocado toast
recipes.description: Smashed avocado on crisp toast.
steps: Toast the bread.
Smash avocado with lemon, salt and chili flakes.
Spread thickly and top with sliced tomato.

recipes.title: Pancakes
recipes.description: Use up milk and eggs in one go.
steps: Whisk 2 eggs, 3 dl milk and 2 dl flour into a smooth batter.
Fry thin pancakes in a buttered pan.
Serve with berries.

recipes.title: Creamy porridge
recipes.description: Oats cooked in milk, topped with fruit.
steps: Simmer 1 dl oats in 2 dl milk for 5 minutes, stirring.
Top with sliced banana or berries.

recipes.title: Berry banana smoothie
recipes.description: Rescue soft bananas and tired berries.
steps: Blend banana, berries, a spoon of oats and water or plant milk until smooth.

recipes.title: Creamy cream-cheese pasta
recipes.description: Cream cheese melts into a silky sauce.
steps: Cook the pasta; keep a cup of pasta water.
Fry garlic and mushrooms, wilt in the spinach.
Stir in cream cheese and pasta water, then toss with the pasta.

recipes.title: Simple tomato pasta
recipes.description: A pantry sauce that welcomes extra veg.
steps: Fry onion, garlic and diced zucchini.
Add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Toss with cooked pasta.

recipes.title: Chickpea & spinach curry
recipes.description: Coconut curry ready in half an hour.
steps: Fry onion and garlic with curry paste or spices.
Add chickpeas and coconut milk; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in spinach and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Red lentil soup
recipes.description: Warming, cheap and full of protein.
steps: Soften onion and carrot.
Add lentils, tomatoes and 1 litre of stock; simmer 20 minutes.
Blend, and swirl in coconut milk.

recipes.title: Tofu veggie stir-fry
recipes.description: Crispy tofu with crunchy veg.
steps: Fry cubed tofu until golden; set aside.
Stir-fry the veg with garlic.
Return the tofu, add soy sauce and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Veggie fried rice
recipes.description: Perfect for leftover rice and odds and ends.
steps: Stir-fry diced veg.
Add cold rice and fry until hot.
Push aside, scramble the eggs, then mix everything with soy sauce.

recipes.title: Roasted Mediterranean veg
recipes.description: Tray of soft veg, great with bread or pasta.
steps: Chop everything into chunks.
Toss with olive oil, salt and herbs.
Roast at 200 °C for 30–35 minutes.

recipes.title: Tzatziki
recipes.description: Cool yogurt dip with cucumber and garlic.
steps: Grate the cucumber and squeeze out the water.
Mix with yogurt, crushed garlic, salt and olive oil.

recipes.title: Yogurt & berry bowl
recipes.description: A quick breakfast that saves your berries.
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Top with berries and toasted oats.

recipes.title: Cheese & tomato toastie
recipes.description: Golden, melty and done in minutes.
steps: Fill bread with cheese and tomato.
Butter the outside and fry until golden on both sides.

recipes.title: Creamy mushrooms on toast
recipes.description: Mushrooms and cream on crisp bread.
steps: Fry mushrooms and garlic until browned.
Add a splash of cream and reduce.
Spoon over toast.

recipes.title: Apple crumble
recipes.description: Wrinkly apples become dessert.
steps: Slice apples into a dish with sugar and cinnamon.
Rub flour, butter, sugar and oats into crumbs.
Scatter over and bake at 190 °C for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Rice pudding
recipes.description: Slow-cooked rice in milk with cinnamon.
steps: Simmer 1 dl rice in 5 dl milk, stirring often, for 30–35 minutes.
Sweeten and finish with cinnamon.

recipes.title: Lemon salmon with potatoes
recipes.description: Omega-3 rich and simple.
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Bake salmon with lemon slices at 200 °C for 12–15 minutes.
Serve with wilted spinach.

recipes.title: Chicken & veg traybake
recipes.description: One tray, minimal washing up.
steps: Chop veg and chicken into chunks.
Toss with oil and seasoning.
Roast at 200 °C for 35–40 minutes until cooked through.

recipes.title: Spaghetti bolognese
recipes.description: The family favourite. Swap half the mince for lentils to go lighter on meat.
steps: Brown the mince with onion, garlic and carrot.
Add tomatoes and simmer 20 minutes.
Serve over pasta.

recipes.title: Ham & cheese omelette
recipes.description: A hearty omelette.
steps: Whisk the eggs.
Pour into a hot pan, add ham and cheese.
Fold when just set.
